description.value: Steveston Seafood House is an award-winning fine dining restaurant in the heart of historic Steveston village, celebrated for its creative Pacific seafood menus built around locally sourced BC ingredients including Qualicum Bay scallops, Salt Spring Island mussels, and daily-catch fish. The menu also draws on the Calabrian coastal cooking traditions of the chef's family, weaving West Coast bounty with rustic Italian heritage across dinner, lunch, and weekend brunch services. Steveston sits at the terminus of popular Metro Vancouver cycling routes along the waterfront and dyke trail network.
